title: Best Practices
description: Fleet Fisheries strives to maintain a sustainable seafood industry adhering to the guidelines and rules of N.O.A.A. and other agencies. Read about some of our best practices that we use on a daily basis along with modern technology.
text: BEST PRACTICES GENERATIONS OF KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE COUPLED WITH TECHNOLOGY / INNOVATION, SEAFOOD SAFETY, ADHERENCE TO FEDERAL REGULATIONS AND HARD TEAMWORK IS OUR RECIPE FOR QUALITY & EXCELLENCE IN SEAFOOD Leading the way to enjoy seafood for generations to come... Recognizing the need for sustainability, Fleet Fisheries works along-side federal agencies, industry associations and the marine life scientific community to manage the fishery more effectively, as well as protecting the ecology of the oceans to pave the way for future generations for years and years to come! Learn more about these industry agencies please click to visit our Sustainability page . The harvest of the North Atlantic Sea Scallop is also protected for future generations by limiting the size of the scallop being harvested. The increased size of the "rings" on the dredge allows less mature scallops to leave the dredge thus maintaining a balance of the species that will continue to grow. Fleet Fisheries, along with the entire Northeast sea scallop fleet, uses the latest monitoring technology to ensure that are fleet are harvesting within NOAA territories. This technology is essential to the management of the fishery in order to become a recognized sustainable fishery. AGENCIES & ORGANIZATIONS THAT FLEET WORKS TOGETHER WITH... title: Fleet Facilities
description: Fleet Fisheries uses the latest technology, advanced food safety protocols and has multiple state-of-art facilities to strive for the excellence in seafood synonymous with our company name.
text: FLEET FACILITIES OUR STRATEGICALLY-LOCATED STATE-OF-THE-ART FACILITIES HELP IMPROVE OVERALL EFFICIENCY & PRESERVE OUR LEGACY OF EXCELLENCE IN THE SEAFOOD INDUSTRY Fleet Fisheries Inc. shore side facilities are all located in historic New Bedford, Massachusetts. Located directly on the New Bedford harbor, we unload our fleet at our own receiving facility where our initial inspection process begins. Our shore management team inspects our catch for wholesomeness, size, and weight. Once the catch is offloaded into temperature-controlled trucks in special storage containers, they make their way to our production facilities for the grading process. Our two (2) facilities, include a 20,000 square foot Individual Quick Frozen (IQF) plant and our main 45,000 square foot fresh processing plant, are state of the art! We employ over 60 highly trained production associates between both facilities. The main facility also contains over 25,000 square feet of cooler space and a 40,000 lb. capacity lobster pool. Newly added, we a state-of-the-art live drip system where we can house an additional 60,000 lbs. of live lobster and crab! This system allow us to keep live product longer in our inventory, decrease mortality, filter the water the lobsters & crabs live in better and inventory our product easier. Furthermore, with the addition of this new piece of equipment, we are able to grade lobsters and crabs at a much more rapid pace than we were able to when doing it manually by hand, which also helps to decrease mortality rates. You can rest assured that all of our seafood is the best quality that you will find anywhere and harvested with hard work and a long-time pride for providing excellent product to our customers! See our certifications...

text: QUALITY ASSURANCE FLEET FISHERIES' PRIMARY COMMITMENT IS TO QUALITY SEAFOOD Our Commitment To Quality Starts At The Top With the resources in place, coupled with knowledgeable, HACCP trained personnel and a Firm Commitment From Senior Management, Fleet Fisheries is ahead of the curve when it comes to providing our customers with Quality Seafood. Every lot of our scallops is subjected to a battery of tests and examinations designed to ensure maximum customer satisfaction. In addition to the standard organoleptic testing common throughout the seafood industry, the Quality Control Department at Fleet Fisheries applies several additional tests that measure moisture content, evaluate both raw and cooked texture, measure uniformity of size and color and monitor for extraneous materials often associated with fresh scallops.

title: Sustainability
description: BACKED BY DECADES OF SEAFOOD & FISHING EXPERIENCE, FLEET FISHERIES UNDERSTANDS THE IMPORTANCE OF KEEPING OUR INDUSTRY SUSTAINABLE.
text: SUSTAINABILITY BACKED BY DECADES OF SEAFOOD & FISHING EXPERIENCE, FLEET FISHERIES UNDERSTANDS THE IMPORTANCE OF KEEPING OUR INDUSTRY SUSTAINABLE. Fleet Fisheries Inc. prides itself in being purveyors of fine, quality seafood backed by decades of experience & knowledge in the seafood industry. We understand how important it is to keep our industry sustainable for generations to come. Fleet Fisheries works with and is in complete cooperation with NOAA / National Marine Fisheries Service in its goals to maintain the natural resources of the beautiful & bountiful oceans. The sustainability of the North Atlantic Sea Scallop is critical to the livelihood of thousands of fishermen and shore businesses. Since 2001 the scallop industry has been considered a recovered fisheries after almost being depleted by over fishing in the 1980s and 1990s. Similar guidelines and regulations apply to our lobster, crab, swordfish, tuna and other fisheries' vessels as well put forth by the same organizations making all of the great, quality seafood that Fleet Fisheries provides to ours customers a very sustainable industry! title: Traceability
description: SEAFOOD TRACEABLE FROM THE SEA TO THE SHORE TO YOUR DOOR
text: TRACEABILITY SEAFOOD TRACEABLE FROM THE SEA TO THE SHORE TO YOUR DOOR Today, the issue of traceability is on the lips of the consumer, the distributor, the processor and the harvester. Fleet Fisheries, having dozens of vessels in its fleet, is truly a vertically integrated seafood company. We track each of our boats and use this capability to create unique traceability programs for our committed customers. Each lot of our fresh sea scallops are traced from the boat (even if we purchase from independent vessels) to our customers for true traceability! Fleet Fisheries uses modern-day software to manage all of its daily operations from tracking and communicating with the vessels out at sea to the inventory management and lot control. Additionally, the seafood is always kept cold on fresh ice, in refrigerated trucks, coolers, freezers and even our main facility is air-controlled with a specially-designed air system that maintains the production floors at a controlled temperature! We can tell the temperature of all seafood whether it was in one of our coolers, refrigerated trucks, freezers or even while it is traveling by freight airliners thanks to the time-temperature indicators. Learn More - By Juliet Eilperin and Tim Carman, The Washington Post, Feb. 21, 2013
